Don't miss the Season 2 Teaser Trailer for 3 Body Problem, the hit sci-fi action series distributed by Netflix. What's been watching comes to light in Season 2 of 3 Body Problem, streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.

As the alien invasion nears, humanity prepares to meet them — on Earth and beyond.  While a space fleet embarks on a mission that spans centuries, a secret locked inside of one man's mind might be humanity's only hope for survival.

3 Body Problem stars Jess Hong, Benedict Wong, Eiza Gonzalez, Jovan Adepo, Saamer Usmani, Liam Cunningham, Marlo Kelly, Sea Shimooka, Claudia Doumit, Ellie De Lange, and more. The series is directed by Jeremy Podeswa (201, 202, 203), Miguel Sapochnik (204, 205, 206), and is written by David Benioff, D.B. Weiss, Alexander Woo (201), Rose Cartwright (202), Alexander Woo (203), Nichelle Tramble Spellman (204), David Benioff & D.B. Weiss (205, 206).

Season 2 of 3 Body Problem is streaming on January 14, 2027, on Netflix.

description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar went to great lengths to hide the identities of the dual protagonists of GTA 6, but that didn't stop rumors from hitting the internet. One of the names tossed around for Lucia was Manni L. Perez, and it turns out the internet was right. The Game Awards revealed their list of nominees and Perez was nominated for Best Performance. The actor playing Jason, however, is still a mystery. And speaking of, GTA 6 leads in The Game Awards nominations, including Game of the Year. And finally, Sony has fought off a $2.6 billion lawsuit claiming they hold a 'near monopoly' through their PlayStation Store.
title: GTA 6's Lucia Actress Confirmed — And It's Who You Think It Is - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Barely a full month after Paramount Skydance closed their acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, news came that James Gunn and Peter Safran are exiting as the heads of DC Studios. Whether you were a fan of Gunn’s approach to DC’s characters or not, announcing a full slate of film and television series only to be forced out four years later with several projects midway through development is a heck of a way to end things.

While we don’t know if the DCU will continue or will be rebooted yet again under new head Jeremy Latcham, the shake-up indicates that Gunn’s plans will not survive in their current form.

Given how many times DC’s film strategy has changed over the past decade, we can’t help but ask: is the DC Cinematic Universe just cursed? Will we ever see a stable version of DC’s world on the big screen, or will it forever live in the shadow of the MCU? Watch the video for the full story.

#IGN #Movies #DC
title: The DC Cinematic Universe Is Cursed

description:
Littlelands is available now in Steam Early Access for Windows PC. Step into the vibrant, cute world of Littlelands in this early access launch trailer for the adventure game that blends cozy life simulation with classic action-adventure.

In Littlelands, even the smallest discoveries can lead to unforgettable adventures.

Explore a colorful region brimming with curious creatures, hidden pathways, mysterious ruins, and quirky inhabitants who might just need a helping hand. Take on quests, uncover secrets, and discover new places as you journey beyond the safety of town.

But adventure isn't always about swinging a sword.

Spend a peaceful afternoon fishing, catching insects, tending to your garden, or decorating your surroundings. Restore a farm, customize your character, and settle into a world where there's no pressure to rush from one adventure to the next.

#IGN #Gaming

description:
Check out the trailer for Remain, an upcoming film starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty, and Jay O. Sanders.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

 M. Night Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Nicholas Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.
title: Remain - Official Trailer (2027) Jake Gyllenhaal, Phoebe Dynevor
